about: reconciliation of the seven bank 0 notes files (b0_61b6 .. b0_c4ca): one name for each RAM address they named twice, the Star Wars names and comments that sat on the wrong routine or line dropped and replaced, the sound command stubs named by command number, and the texts of the b0 files that used a losing or a missing name repeated here with the name the listing shows. a wave is what GM_WAV counts, a part is one of its four (probots, walkers, TIE fighters, asteroid field)

4867.name: rheop_sp
4867.desc: RHS_SP+RHEOP: spread multiplier of the pitch pot. PHERES sets it from the pot limits saved in NVRAM and game_vars_init bumps it at every game start

486F.name: RHEOR
486F.desc: ROLL BLOCK (Atari's name, $4870 in Star Wars): laid over the yaw block RHEOY one byte up, only its RHS_RSD byte at $4877 is used. s1_roll_add and gd_roll_apply hand it to RHRSDU

4870.name: rheoy_sp
4870.desc: RHS_SP+RHEOY: spread multiplier of the yaw pot, kept as rheop_sp is

4876.name: rheoy_rsd
4876.desc: RHS_RSD+RHEOY: yaw tics still to be turned. twirl_ground adds the yoke's yaw to it, RHRSDU takes whole magic steps out of it and RESIDU turns the downloaded unit vectors by the rest

4877.name: rheor_rsd
4877.desc: RHS_RSD+RHEOR: roll tics still to be turned. s1_roll_add adds the steady roll of the TIE fighter and asteroid parts to it, RESIDU turns the view by what is left, OLD1SHP clears it

488C.name: gs_fade
488C.desc: brightness of the shield segment just lost: DO1GAS sets $F0, VWGAS takes 8 off each frame and ends the loss (GS_HIT and GS_GLW cleared) at zero. the IRQ puts it in the colour instruction at $002E in vector RAM, which the lost segment and the gauge's entry 0 colour are drawn with

4894.name: GD_ROL
4894.desc: ROLL AMOUNT AFTER HIT (Atari's name, $48A5 in Star Wars): word. in S1TWGD first the roll wanted from the hit count S_ROL and the yoke, then the limited step that is added to GD_ACT this frame. cleared when the probot part starts

48CD.name: vg_set
48CD.desc: number (0-3) of the display list set that load_vg_set last copied from program ROM to the pseudo vector ROM at $2800, kept so that the set can be loaded again after a buffer overrun or a vector generator time out. the self test uses the same byte as the low byte of SWNEW

4BEE.name: cont_wave
4BEE.desc: the wave (as GM_WAV, from 0) the next game may start on. Copied from pend_wave at the end of a game in which the Jedi bonus was earned - 3 or more sends the end of game to the continue offer screen. Cleared when the offer runs out.

4BEF.name: cont_bonus
4BEF.desc: 4 BCD bytes ($4BEF-$4BF2), 8 digits: the bonus that goes with cont_wave, the score an earlier game had when it finished its last wave. copied from pend_bonus at the end of a game in which the Jedi bonus was earned, shown on the continue screen and with message $52, and added to the score by scr_level_bonus when a game started at wave 4 or higher finishes its first wave

4BF1.name: cont_bonus_2
4BF1.desc: word: third and fourth bytes of cont_bonus, digits 4-1

4BF3.name: pend_wave
4BF3.desc: pending continue offer: GM_WAV + 1 noted by phi_next_set each time a wave is completed. it becomes cont_wave at the end of the game if the Jedi bonus was earned, and is cleared with the offer when the continue screen times out

4BF4.name: pend_bonus
4BF4.desc: 4 BCD bytes: the score (S_SC87 to S_SC21) when pend_wave was noted. it becomes cont_bonus

4BF6.name: pend_bonus_2
4BF6.desc: word: third and fourth bytes of pend_bonus, digits 4-1

4C49.name: GM_WAV
4C49.desc: OVERALL GAME WAVE # (Atari's name, $4B15 in Star Wars): the wave being played, counted from 0 - a wave being the four parts probots, walkers, TIE fighters and asteroid field. 0, 1 or 2 from the select screen (easy, medium, hard), cont_wave from the continue offer, one more after each completed wave, held at $FF. begin_act_init copies it to the level of each part and makes wave_bcd from it

4C4A.name: wave_bcd
4C4A.desc: wave number in BCD as the score line shows it: 1 after reset, GM_WAV + 1 (at most 99) when a wave begins. bank 1's bookkeeping keeps the highest value

4C4C.name: w1_level
4C4C.desc: level of wave 1, set to GM_WAV at the start of each set of four waves. Its double plus diff_adder is wave 1's fire_level, and page 2 picks wave 1 behaviour by it.

4C4D.name: w2_level
4C4D.desc: level of wave 2, set to GM_WAV at the start of each set of four waves.

4C4E.name: w4_level
4C4E.desc: level of the asteroid part: a copy of GM_WAV made by begin_act_init when a wave begins. twice it plus diff_adder is that part's fire_level, and page 2 takes the number of asteroids in flight from it (P2_95B5). (the TIE fighter part's level is SP_WAV)

4C4F.name: wave_type
4C4F.desc: which of the four parts of a wave is being played: 0 probots, 1 walkers, 2 TIE fighters, 3 asteroid field. set by the init of each part, cleared by begin_act_init. it picks the enemy name of the status display, the training manual section and the phase the manual returns to, the laser sound and several speeches

4C50.name: jedi_time
4C50.desc: 3 bytes, the last a fraction: time left of the state that follows the completion of the four Jedi letters, the Jedi force. page 1 sets the top word to $01C0 when the fourth letter is earned and counts it down every frame (P1_95F1) at a rate picked by jedi_count. 0 = not running, the game start clears the top word. while it runs the cockpit and the lazar splash take the force colour and the shield gauge is not drawn, under $60 they blink on its bit 3. the setups of the walker, TIE fighter and asteroid parts send their music only when it is under $80

4C53.name: bonus_left
4C53.desc: enemies still to shoot in the current part for its bonus and Jedi letter: loaded from the part's quota by its init, counted down by the routines that score a kill, shown with the enemy's name by vw_wave_left and in the SHOOT nn FOR BONUS messages. while it is not 0 a kill scores the small amount, the kill that brings it to 0 earns 5,000 points and the letter (P1_9573), and later kills score ten times the small amount

4C55.name: quota_probot
4C55.desc: bonus quota of the probot part, the bonus_left that part starts with: set from the starting wave by set_bonus_quota (6, 8, 10, then GM_WAV + 9), one more each time the part's letter is earned and after each wave (phi_next_set), 90 at most

4C56.name: quota_walker
4C56.desc: bonus quota of the walker part, kept as quota_probot is

4C57.name: quota_tie
4C57.desc: bonus quota of the TIE fighter part, kept as quota_probot is

4C58.name: quota_astrd
4C58.desc: fourth bonus quota, set by set_bonus_quota and raised by phi_next_set with the other three. phi_asteroids loads it into bonus_left, which the status display does not show in the asteroid part

4C5A.name: diff_adder
4C5A.desc: difficulty adder, Star Wars' GM_DIF by the code that keeps it: the difficulty option (bits 3-2 of the option byte $4D7B) when a game starts, plus diff_step after each of the first three waves (GM_WAV 0 to 2). twice a part's level plus this is fire_level, and page 2 adds it to the asteroid part's level

4C5B.name: fire_level
4C5B.desc: level the current part is played at, 0-$1F: twice the part's level plus diff_adder, with $20 and up folded into $10-$1F. each part's setup writes it, the enemy gun code of page 1 indexes its shot tables with it and fires when a 5 bit random number is below it. the probot part steps it up every 32 frames once its quota is met or 100 frames have passed

4C60.name: craft_type
4C60.desc: which craft the player flies: 0 in the probot and walker parts, 1 in the TIE fighter and asteroid parts. picks the cockpit list of view_cockpit and the laser origins of page 3 P3_95D3, where type 1 has a second pair of guns

4C61.name: manual_on
4C61.desc: 1 when the player picked one of the two instructions targets on the select screen: the init of each part then goes to phase $43 to show its training manual page first. cleared when the first wave is finished (phi_next_set) and when a game starts from the continue offer

4C62.name: start_bonus
4C62.desc: 1 from the start of a game (PHISG2) until its first wave is finished: the bonus for the wave the game started on is still due. phase $32 shows it (vew_wave_bonus), adds it (scr_level_bonus) and clears the flag. still set at the end of a game it selects message $30 on the continue screen

4C72.name: rank_index
4C72.desc: index of the high score table entry (7 bytes each in INITLS) the player's score has to reach next: $18, the last of the 25, at reset and at game start, stepped down by bank 1 KE209 each frame the score has reached that entry, minus when the score is the best. the score display shows that entry and the player's place from it

4C84.name: jedi_on
4C84.desc: set again every frame by page 1 P1_9645: 1 while jedi_time is running or a letter is growing into place (jedi_show 1), else 0. the cockpit, the star and the lazar splash drawing take another colour while it is set. cleared at game start

4C85.name: jedi_done
4C85.desc: 1 once all four Jedi letters have been earned in this game (page 1 P1_95E2), cleared by PHISG2. at the end of the game it turns the pending continue offer into the offer and picks the message of the continue screen

4CAE.name: ph_col_brt
4CAE.desc: PH_COL+1, the brightness byte of the phase colour, where the listing shows it as a bare address: the attract pages step it down to fade their messages and the message drawing (mes_lines_fade) takes the brightness of every line from it

4CB8.name: man_done
4CB8.desc: $FF when the script of a training manual page has reached its end record (man_op_end), cleared by phi_manual. phe_manual leaves the page when it is set

4CB9.name: man_running
4CB9.desc: nonzero while a training manual page is shown (phases $43 and $44): phi_manual bumps it, phe_manual and begin_act_init clear it. the slapstic pages then leave out sounds and speech, place their objects by fixed values, fire at once when the script asks and do not count the demonstration as play

4CBA.name: sc_add_top
4CBA.desc: SC_ADD-1: the top two BCD digits of the amount last added to the score, which is shown as 8 digits from here. zero except for the continued play bonus

4CBF.name: legs_bonus
4CBF.desc: 3 BCD bytes ($4CBF-$4CC1): the progressive bonus for flying through an AT-AT's legs. cleared by the walker part's setup, raised by 5,000 up to 900,000 and added to the score by scr_legs_bonus each time page 0 (P0_87DD) sees the player pass under a walker, shown while legs_bon_tmr runs

4CCA.name: snd_mute
4CCA.desc: nonzero mutes the sound effects: doxmt_gated, and bank 1's copy of it at K6530, send their command only while it is 0. the five dying phases set it to 1, the starting wave select, the continue offer, begin_act_init and PHEEGM clear it

4CCC.name: exec_x
4CCC.desc: word: screen x of the Executor in the TIE fighter part, saved sign extended by VWDTHB from its projected centre. exec_drift_left moves it 16 to the left every frame in phase $2A, which ends when it is -520 or less

4CD5.name: w2_spk_cnt
4CD5.desc: wave 2: counts the frames a page 0 test (P0_8F45) holds running. At 20 the speech spk_cmd_03 is started and the count parks at $80. Cleared by the wave 2 setup.

4CD7.name: hit_spk_done
4CD7.desc: wave 2: nonzero once the speech spk_cmd_09 has been started by page 0 (P0_9641), or is no longer wanted - the end of wave init bumps it.

4CDE.name: foa_said
4CDE.desc: set by page 2 P2_92EE once it has sent the sound command of spk_cmd_05, so that it is sent once in a game. cleared at game start

4CDF.name: legs_bon_tmr
4CDF.desc: frames the legs bonus stays on screen: 20 from scr_legs_bonus, counted down by page 1 (P1_9D45) while it shows legs_bonus

5032.name: M_BY1
5032.desc: Ship 1 unit vector B, Y (Atari's name, the same address in Star Wars, MS_BY+M_U1): word, the y part of the ship's side axis in the ship 1 download block

5034.name: M_BZ1
5034.desc: Ship 1 unit vector B, Z (Atari's name, MS_BZ+M_U1): word, the y part of the ship's up axis in the ship 1 download block

503A.name: M_CY1
503A.desc: Ship 1 unit vector C, Y (Atari's name, MS_CY+M_U1): word, the z part of the ship's side axis in the ship 1 download block

503C.name: M_CZ1
503C.desc: Ship 1 unit vector C, Z (Atari's name, MS_CZ+M_U1): word, the z part of the ship's up axis in the ship 1 download block

5042.name: M_YT1
5042.desc: SHIP 1 UNIVERSE LOC (Atari's name in Star Wars, MS_TY+M_U1): word, y of the ship 1 download block's position, a copy of the player's

5044.name: M_ZT1
5044.desc: SHIP 1 UNIVERSE LOC (Atari's name in Star Wars, MS_TZ+M_U1): word, z (height) of the ship 1 download block's position, a copy of the player's

5080.name: s1_ax
5080.desc: MS_AX+M_S1: unit vector A,X of the player's ship, word ($4000 = 1.0): the x part of its forward axis, plus when the ship heads towards +x. $C0 in its high byte with the same in s1_by turns the ship to face backwards

5086.name: s1_vx
5086.desc: word: the player's forward speed, MS_VX+M_S1 (the listing shows the same address as that expression in the carried lines). asteroid_setup sets it to $0100 for the asteroid field

508A.name: s1_by
508A.desc: MS_BY+M_S1: unit vector B,Y of the player's ship, word: the y part of its side axis. the carried lines show the same address as that expression

509C.name: s1_tz
509C.desc: MS_TZ+M_S1: the player's universe z position, word: the height above the ground in the probot and walker parts. the part setups preset it and the movement routines keep it within the part's limits

B0:630A.name: IPARM
B0:630A.desc: Star Wars' IPARM, which the matcher missed: init the general parameters (init_general) and the player's ship (NW1SHP)

B0:64A3.name: PHEINS
B0:64A3.desc: phase $06, Star Wars' PHEINS changed: one frame of the flight instructions page. score, coin lines, the page (view_ins_page), stars and Jedi letters, the stars move sideways. when view_ins_page has set the timer to $200 it goes on to the design team page. flashes the Jedi letters and checks the start and test switches

B0:6559.name: PHESCR
B0:6559.desc: phase $04, Star Wars' PHESCR changed: one frame of the scoring page. score, coin lines, the page (VWPAGE), stars and Jedi letters, the stars move up. when VWPAGE has set the timer to $200 it goes on to the flight instructions. flashes the Jedi letters and checks the start and test switches

B0:6671.name: team_page_init
B0:6671.desc: phase $07, init of the design team page: message offset and timer 0, messages off, full brightness, message $01 (Atari's game design team) on

B0:668D.name: team_page_exec
B0:668D.desc: phase $08, one frame of the design team page: score, coin lines, stars, Jedi letters and the message, the stars move up. from frame $A0 the message fades two steps a frame, and when it is dark the timer is set to $100, which ends the phase: on to the high score table. flashes the Jedi letters and checks the start and test switches

B0:66E9.name: PHIHIS
B0:66E9.desc: phase $09 (PHS_HIS), Star Wars' PHIHIS with the timer started at 0: init of the high score table display. blue for the table, messages off, math box and ship restored, stars facing forward, high scores checked for reasonableness by bank 1

B0:6713.name: PHEHIS
B0:6713.desc: phase $0A, Star Wars' PHEHIS with the timer counting up: one frame of the high score table display. draws the copyright message, stars, score, coin lines, the table in the phase colour (faded from frame $B0) and the Jedi letters, moves the stars forward, and after $100 frames goes back to the banner. flashes the Jedi letters and checks the start and test switches

B0:6786.name: PHESG1
B0:6786.desc: phase $0C, the first instructions of Star Wars' PHESG1: clears kill_count, sets phase $0D (select the starting wave) and falls into game_vars_init, the rest of PHESG1

B0:67DA.name: PHISG2
B0:67DA.desc: phase $13, Star Wars' PHISG2 with more to reset: finish starting up the game. math box, parameters and stars, the four bonus quotas from the starting wave (set_bonus_quota), ship facing backwards, bonus coin count, score, foa_said and jedi_done cleared, rank_index at the last entry, start_bonus set and diff_adder taken from the difficulty option. falls into PHESG2

B0:6815.name: PHESG2
B0:6815.desc: phase $14, Star Wars' PHESG2: goes to phase $15 (PHS_BGN), begin a wave

B0:6856.desc: phase $0E, the starting difficulty select screen. Star Wars' PHESDS changed: the table TDTH now has five targets, three planets (easy, medium, hard = GM_WAV 0, 1, 2) and two instructions targets that pick easy and set manual_on. Each frame it hit tests the cursor against the targets with the octagon check, draws the planets, the two instructions pictures, the cursor (yellow when on a target), the messages and a countdown, and goes to phase $0F when a fire or thumb switch is pressed on a target or, on easy, when 256 frames have passed

B0:6980.desc: phase $0F, init of the sequence shown between the select screen and the game: picture set 0, stars (ISTAR), phase timer 0, all messages off, a tune (tune_cmd_2f) and an effect (aud_cmd_47), then falls into the execute phase

B0:69F9.desc: phase $12, the continue offer screen, a second changed copy of Star Wars' PHESDS with one planet at cont_planet. Draws the score, the coin messages, the planet, the cursor, the messages, a countdown, the offered wave number (cont_wave + 1) and its bonus (cont_bonus, 6 or 8 digits). A fire or thumb switch pressed with the cursor on the planet takes a credit, sets GM_WAV to cont_wave and goes straight to phase $13 (PHISG2) - with no credit it puts 256 frames back on the countdown, once. When the timer reaches $200 the offer and the pending offer are cleared and the phase goes back to the banner

B0:6B55.desc: phase $15 (PHS_BGN), begin a set of four waves. Star Wars' PHIBGN changed: resets the ship's flight state (OLD1SHP), makes the BCD wave number for the display from GM_WAV + 1 (at most 99), copies GM_WAV to the level of each of the four wave types, clears wave_type, snd_mute and man_running, then falls into the execute phase

B0:6B8F.desc: phase $17, init of wave 1: picture set 1, wave_type 0, bonus_left from the wave 1 quota, the Jedi letter display turned off unless a letter is being awarded, prog_count cleared. If instructions were asked for it goes to phase $43 (which comes back at wave1_setup), otherwise it falls into wave1_setup

B0:6BB8.desc: phase $45, the rest of the wave 1 init, entered by falling in from wave1_init or from the training manual phase (manual_next_ph): general parameters and a new ship (IPARM) turned to face backwards, ground stars (ISTARG), the wave 1 objects and the progress indicator set up on the slapstic pages, player speed, position and height, timer and the hit speech flags cleared, the part's tune (tune_cmd_2e) and one of two speeches by the low bit of GM_WAV, craft type 0, then phase $18

B0:6C0B.desc: phase $18, the first 40 frames of wave 1 before anything attacks: views the scene (vew_probot), ends the game through phi_probot_die when the shields are gone, runs the shield gauge and the Jedi flags, turns and moves the player, then goes to phase $19

B0:6C3C.desc: phase $19: works out the level wave 1 is played at, 2 * w1_level + diff_adder, folded into $10-$1F once it passes $1F, stores it in fire_level and its two wave 1 copies, clears the phase timer and GD_ROL and falls into the wave 1 play phase (wave1_exec, phase $1A)

B0:6C5F.name: wave1_exec
B0:6C5F.desc: phase $1A, wave 1 play: views with vew_probot, ends the game through phi_probot_die when the shields are gone, moves shots, transmissions, glow, the shield gauge, explosions and the wave 1 objects (page 2 P2_877C), runs the Jedi time, turns and moves the player. at frame 20 it shows the Jedi letters. once the quota is met or 100 frames have passed the level climbs (wave1_level_up), and when prog_count reaches 4 it goes to phase $1B

B0:6CF3.desc: phase $1B, wave 1 is over (prog_count reached 4): timer 0, a speech picked by GM_WAV (0, 1, 2, from 3 up one of the four in w1_end_spk at random), and w1_spawn = $FF so that page 2 frees the wave 1 objects. Falls into phase $1C (wave1_end_exec), which plays on until none is left

B0:6D2B.name: wave1_end_exec
B0:6D2B.desc: phase $1C: plays wave 1 on, as wave1_exec does without the level and indicator tests, until page 2 counts no live object record (w1_active 0), then goes to phase $1D

B0:6D73.desc: phase $1E, the flight out of wave 1: views with vew_probot_end, still moves shots, explosions, glow and the shield gauge, turns the player with L778C and moves him. After 40 frames it waits for the ship to face backwards (unit vector A x at or below $C100) and at 80 frames at the latest goes to phase $1F, the init of wave 2

B0:6DBF.desc: phase $1F, init of wave 2: picture set 1, wave_type 1, bonus_left from the wave 2 quota, the Jedi letter display turned off unless a letter is being awarded. With instructions asked for it goes to phase $43 (which comes back at wave2_setup), otherwise it joins wave2_setup at L6DF3, past the new ship and stars, so the flight carries on from wave 1

B0:6DE5.desc: phase $46, the rest of the wave 2 init, entered from the training manual phase (manual_next_ph) with a new ship facing backwards and ground stars, and at L6DF3 from wave2_init: sets up the two kinds of wave 2 objects and the progress indicator on the slapstic pages, works out fire_level from w2_level and diff_adder, clears the timer, the legs bonus and the speech flags, sends the part's tune (tune_cmd_2b) while jedi_time is under $80 and a speech (spk_cmd_18) and goes to phase $20

B0:6E44.desc: phase $20, wave 2 play: views with LA448, ends the game through phi_walker_die when the shields are gone, moves shots, explosions and the two kinds of wave 2 objects, runs the Jedi time, turns and moves the player. After 1200 frames, or once the quota is met with Jedi time running, it clears adv_hold so nothing holds the advance up. At frame 60 it shows the Jedi letters, and when walk_adv reaches 400 it goes to phase $21

B0:6EB0.desc: phase $21, wave 2 is over: timer 0 and both spawn counts = $FF so that the slapstic pages free the wave 2 objects, the hit speech flag bumped, then phase $22

B0:6F08.desc: phase $23: clears the phase timer, sends a speech (spk_cmd_23) and an effect (aud_cmd_45) and falls into the wave 2 exit phase

B0:6F56.desc: phase $25, init of wave 3: picture set 2, wave_type 2, bonus_left from the wave 3 quota, the Jedi letter display turned off unless a letter is being awarded. With instructions asked for it goes to phase $43 (which comes back at wave3_setup), otherwise it falls into wave3_setup

B0:6F7A.desc: phase $47, the rest of the wave 3 init, entered by falling in from wave3_init or from the training manual phase (manual_next_ph): general parameters and a new ship facing backwards, stars (ISTAR), the wave 3 setup on page 3, fire_level from SP_WAV and diff_adder, timer and hit speech flags cleared, craft type 1 with its second pair of lasers, a speech (spk_cmd_24) and, while jedi_time is under $80, the part's tune (tune_cmd_2c), then phase $26

B0:6FC4.desc: phase $26, wave 3 play, built on Star Wars' PHESP1: views with LA515, ends the game through phi_tie_die when the shields are gone, moves shots, glows, explosions and the computer ships, runs the Jedi time, turns and moves the player and moves the stars. At frame 60 it shows the Jedi letters, after 440 frames it goes to phase $27, and while fewer than three ships are alive it adds another (ADASHP on page 3)

B0:7025.desc: phase $28, the TIE fighter wave after its time is up: the same frame as the wave itself (view LA515, shots, glow, explosions, shields, Jedi timer) but the fighters run away (CPURET) and the player is turned towards the far object (L76A3). when no alien record is in use and unit vector A's X of the player is $3800 or more it goes to phase $29. shields gone goes to phi_tie_die. Star Wars' PHESP2 with the aim test of its PHES0G added

B0:707A.desc: phase $2A, the way out of the TIE fighter wave: view LA599, which slides the far object 16 units to the left every frame, shots, glow, explosions and shields still run, the player keeps turning towards the far object (L76CB) with no fighters left. when the object's screen x exec_x is -520 or less it goes to phase $2B, the asteroid field. shields gone goes to phi_tie_die

B0:70BD.desc: phase $2B, init of the asteroid field wave: pseudo vector ROM set 2, wave_type = 3, bonus count from quota_astrd, Jedi letters hidden unless one is being awarded. if instructions were chosen (manual_on) it goes to phase $43 for the training manual page, which comes back through asteroid_setup, else it branches into asteroid_setup past the object and star set-up

B0:70E3.name: asteroid_setup
B0:70E3.desc: phase $48, the rest of the asteroid part's init, entered from the training manual phase (manual_next_ph) with new parameters and stars, and at L70E9 from phi_asteroids: sets the asteroids up on page 2 (P2_9561), forward speed $0100, fire_level from w4_level and diff_adder, timer and hit_said cleared, craft type 1, the part's tune while jedi_time is under $80 and a speech picked by GM_WAV (0, even, odd), then phase $2C

B0:713E.desc: phase $2C, the asteroid field wave: view LA5F9, shots, explosions, glow, shields, Jedi timer, asteroids moved and launched (P2_96E0), player twirled by twirl_asteroid and moved by S1MVBS. it lasts 300 frames in waves 0 and 1 and 400 in later waves, then phase $2D. 40 frames before the end it requests spk_cmd_20 and stops the asteroids (astrd_max = $FF). 60 frames in it shows the Jedi letters. shields gone goes to L73AA

B0:71D9.desc: phase $2E, the award after the asteroid field: view LA63E with message $4D (5,000 points and Jedi letter awarded), explosions, glow and shields still run. requests spk_cmd_0a at frame 50, shows the Jedi letters at frame 60 if they are hidden, and goes to phase $2F after 70 frames. shields gone goes to L73AA

B0:722D.desc: phase $31, init of the wave completed screen: pseudo vector ROM set 2, phase timer cleared, all messages off, speech request spk_cmd_0c, 2,500 points added (LB65D), then it falls into phase $32

B0:7274.desc: phase $33, first half of going on to the next set of four waves: objects and the player's ship reset, manual_on cleared, the four bonus quotas (probots, walkers, TIE fighters, quota_astrd) each one higher with 90 as the top, and the wave to continue from (GM_WAV + 1) with the score so far saved in pend_wave and pend_bonus. falls into phase $34

B0:72C4.desc: phase $34, second half: in waves 0 to 2 diff_step goes up by one and is added to diff_adder, then the wave number GM_WAV goes up by one (it stays at $FF) and PHASE = PHS_BGN starts the next set

B0:72E4.name: phi_probot_die
B0:72E4.desc: phase $35, init of the player's death in the probot part (the probot phases branch here when S_GAS goes minus), Star Wars' PHIS0D with a mute added: drops the waiting speech (spk_cmd_13), PHASE = $36, phase timer cleared, snd_mute = 1. falls into the execute half

B0:72F6.desc: phase $36, execute half of phi_probot_die, the death of the player in the probot wave (the probot phases branch to phi_probot_die when S_GAS goes minus): view vew_probot_die with the growing GAME OVER, shots still move, the glow is kept flashing, speech request spk_cmd_1a at frame 8, and after 40 frames PHASE = PHS_EGM

B0:731F.name: phi_walker_die
B0:731F.desc: phase $37 (PHS_G0D), init of the player's death in the walker part (the walker phases branch here when S_GAS goes minus), Star Wars' PHIG0D with a mute added: drops the waiting speech (spk_cmd_13), PHASE = $38, phase timer cleared, snd_mute = 1. falls into the execute half

B0:7331.name: phe_walker_die
B0:7331.desc: phase $38, the death of the player in the walker part, Star Wars' PHEG0D: view vew_walker_die with the growing GAME OVER, shots still move, the glow is kept flashing, speech request spk_cmd_1a at frame 8, and after 40 frames PHASE = PHS_EGM

B0:735A.name: phi_tie_die
B0:735A.desc: phase $39, init of the player's death in the TIE fighter part (the TIE fighter phases branch here when S_GAS goes minus): drops the waiting speech (spk_cmd_13), PHASE = $3A, phase timer cleared, snd_mute = 1. falls into the execute half

B0:736C.name: phe_tie_die
B0:736C.desc: phase $3A, the death of the player in the TIE fighter part, Star Wars' PHES0D: view vew_tie_die with the growing GAME OVER, shots still move, the glow is kept flashing, the aliens' glow and the explosions run, and the craft rolls 4.48 degrees a frame. speech request spk_cmd_1b at frame 8, after 40 frames PHASE = PHS_EGM

B0:73AA.desc: phase $3B, init of the death of the player in the asteroid field (reached by branch from phases $2C and $2E): speech request spk_cmd_13, PHASE = $3C, asteroids stopped (astrd_max = $FF), phase timer cleared, snd_mute = 1 which mutes the sound effects sent through LC4DA. falls into the execute half

B0:73C1.desc: phase $3C, the death in the asteroid field: view LA66A with the growing GAME OVER, glow kept flashing, explosions, the asteroids still move, and the craft rolls 4.48 degrees a frame as in phe_tie_die. speech request spk_cmd_1b at frame 8, after 40 frames PHASE = PHS_EGM

B0:73FC.desc: phase $3D, init of a fifth dying phase: speech request spk_cmd_13, PHASE = $3E, phase timer cleared, snd_mute = 1, falls into the execute half. reached only through the phase table and no instruction was found that sets phase $3D

B0:740E.desc: phase $3E: view vew_die_plain (score, Jedi letters, shields and the growing GAME OVER, no scene), glow kept flashing, speech request spk_cmd_1a at frame 8, after 40 frames PHASE = PHS_EGM

B0:7434.name: PHIEGM
B0:7434.desc: phase $3F (PHS_EGM), Star Wars' PHIEGM without its farewell speech: drops the waiting speech (spk_cmd_13) and falls into PHEEGM

B0:7439.name: PHEEGM
B0:7439.desc: phase $40, Star Wars' PHEEGM with the continue offer added: math box, parameters and stars restored, Jedi letters shown, jedi_blink and snd_mute cleared, then bank 1 does the accounting (EEACCT) and looks for a new high score. with one it goes to phase $41, the initials. else, if the Jedi bonus was earned, the pending offer becomes the continue offer, and an offer of wave 4 or higher goes to phase $11. else a speech (only when the game ended in the probot or walker part) and a tune are sent and the phase is the banner

B0:74BC.name: PHEENT
B0:74BC.desc: phase $42, Star Wars' PHEENT with the continue offer added: the initials entry. score, coin lines, the high score table and the messages, bank 1's GETINT takes the initials. the test switch or $280 frames end it. when it is done the pending offer becomes the continue offer if the Jedi bonus was earned, and the phase is $11 for an offer of wave 4 or higher, else $09, the high score table

B0:751F.name: phi_manual
B0:751F.desc: phase $43, init of a training manual page, entered from the init of a part when manual_on is set: new parameters and ground stars, the ship facing forward ($40 in s1_ax and s1_by), the page of section wave_type set up (manual_page_init), timer and man_done cleared, man_running bumped

B0:7542.desc: phase $44, execute half of phi_manual, one page of the rebel training manual shown before a wave when instructions were chosen: view LA697, then LB189 runs the page's script and the demonstration of part wave_type. when the script ends (man_done) or after 400 frames PHASE is taken from manual_next_ph for the wave type ($45 probots, $46 walkers, $47 TIE fighters, $48 asteroids, each the wave's own set-up) and the glow, the hit and man_running are cleared

B0:75AC.desc: sets the four bonus quotas (quota_probot, quota_walker, quota_tie, quota_astrd) from the starting wave number GM_WAV: 6, 8, 10 from quota_tab for waves 0 to 2, GM_WAV + 9 for later waves. called by PHISG2 when a game starts

B0:75E1.name: PHESTS
B0:75E1.desc: phase $4A, Star Wars' PHESTS: the statistics page, drawn by bank 1 (K712B). the aux switch goes on to the option page (phase $4B), the test switch off goes back to the banner

B0:7619.name: PHEOPT
B0:7619.desc: phase $4C, Star Wars' PHEOPT: the option page, drawn and changed by bank 1 (K76AD, K773E). the aux switch jumps to HANG, so the watchdog resets the machine, the test switch off goes back to the banner

B0:766C.desc: star movement of the high score table phase, called by PHEHIS: ST_UX $80 further, forward. the same instructions as Star Wars' SMVHIS, which the matcher missed

B0:76A3.desc: twirls the player while the TIE fighters run away (phase $28): the roll after a hit, then AIMDTH aims at the far object, pitch and yaw. instruction for instruction Star Wars' STWSP2

B0:7750.desc: no caller found, dead code: adds the low byte of GD_ROL to the roll residue, runs the residue routine L7BB1 on the roll block and rolls the ship (S1RL) when it asks. this is the end of Star Wars' S1TWGD, which ESB's S1TWGD no longer runs into

B0:779A.name: twirl_asteroid
B0:779A.desc: twirls the player in the asteroid part (phase $2C): Star Wars' STWSP1 once more - the roll after a hit while S_ROL counts back to zero, AIM, pitch and yaw from the yoke - with 12 tics of roll the other way added every frame through s1_roll_add

B0:7B3E.desc: Star Wars' S1RHPT, ship 1 rheostat pitch: RHTRIG and RHRSDU on the pitch block RHEOP, and S1PT pitches the ship when a magic step is due

B0:7B4D.desc: Star Wars' S1RHYW, ship 1 rheostat yaw: RHTRIG and RHRSDU on the yaw block RHEOY, and S1YW yaws the ship when a magic step is due

B0:7B6E.name: VGTOSITE
B0:7B6E.desc: Star Wars' VGTOSITE, which the matcher missed: with interrupts off it copies the IRQ's rheostat values VG_RSY, VG_RSX, VG_CY and VG_CX into the sight values SI_RSY, SI_RSX, SI_CY and SI_CX that the mainline uses

B0:A39D.name: vew_probot
B0:A39D.desc: view of the probot part (phases $18, $1A and $1C): downloads the ship's vectors and turns them by the residues and the bank (bank_roll_u1), then score, Jedi letters, shields, page 1 P1_9A0E, sight and cockpit (VWSITE), ground stars, the lazar test (TSTLAZ) and its ground splash, gun shots, the transmissions (page 3 P3_9B6D), the probots (page 2 P2_8FB7), their lazar collision test (page 3 P3_9838), the lazars (page 3 P3_95D3), explosions and glow

B0:A3DC.name: vew_probot_end
B0:A3DC.desc: view of the flight out of the probot part (phase $1E): call for call the same as vew_probot

B0:A41B.name: vew_probot_die
B0:A41B.desc: view of the player dying in the probot part (phase $36): score, Jedi letters, shields, ground stars, gun shots, the transmissions (page 3 P3_9B6D), the probots (page 2 P2_8FB7), the growing GAME OVER message (VWMOVR) and glow, no sight and no lazars

B0:A448.desc: view of the walker wave (phases $20 and $22). As vew_probot, which views the probot wave, with the walker views (page 1 P1_88FD, page 0 P0_891A, page 0 P0_969D) and their lazar collision test (page 3 P3_97CB) in place of the probot ones

B0:A4E8.name: vew_walker_die
B0:A4E8.desc: view of the player dying in the walker part (phase $38): score, Jedi letters, shields, ground stars, gun shots, the walkers (page 1 P1_88FD, page 0 P0_891A), the growing GAME OVER message and glow

B0:A5CF.desc: view for phe_tie_die, the player dying in the TIE fighter wave: residue, score, shields, stars, explosions, alien ships, guns, the growing GAME OVER message and glow, no sight and no lazars. The ESB form of Star Wars VEWS0D

B0:A697.desc: view of the rebel training manual pages of the attract mode (phase after phi_manual): residue, score, shields, guns and LB20A, which shows 'REBEL TRAINING MANUAL SECTION' with its numbers and the objects of the wave being explained

B0:A711.name: vew_die_plain
B0:A711.desc: view of phase $3E: score, Jedi letters, shields, the picture at the start of the pseudo ROM set and the growing GAME OVER message, no scene

B0:A729.name: vew_stars_only
B0:A729.desc: no caller found: a view with score, Jedi letters, shields, sight and cockpit, stars and glow only, the shape of Star Wars' VEWHPB without its Death Star

B0:A843.desc: draws the Executor (the star destroyer picture at $298E in the pseudo ROM) coming in from the right near the end of the asteroid wave. nothing is drawn until PH_TIM reaches 260 (360 when GM_WAV is 2 or more), then the picture goes at y 200, x 530 - 7 * frames since then, at scale $7400. called by the view LA5F9. Y-->VG list

B0:B0E4.desc: starts one page of the rebel training manual, called by phi_manual. turns all messages off, calls the set-up routine of section wave_type (0 probot, 1 walkers, 2 TIE fighter, 3 asteroids) from manual_init_tab, then points the script pointer $4CB6 at the script of that section's page $4CB5, taken from manual_script_tab

B0:B189.desc: the per-frame work of a manual page, called by the phase routine at L7542. if the time word of the script record at $4CB6 has been reached by PH_TIM it runs the record's command (byte 2, 0-6, through the table at LAE14, with U at the record: end of page, message on, message off, store byte, store word, call routine, nothing) and steps the pointer on 8 bytes - one record a frame at most. then it calls the move routine of section wave_type from manual_move_tab. the task text gives this as LB18A

B0:B20A.desc: draws a manual page, called by the view routine at LA697 with Y at the display list. turns on message $53 (REBEL TRAINING MANUAL   SECTION), views the messages, writes the section and page numbers after the heading as n.n, then calls the view routine of section wave_type from manual_view_tab

B0:B214.desc: not a separate routine, the rest of manual_view (no call or jump to this address was found): colour, a move to the end of the heading, section number wave_type + 1, a period, page number man_page + 1, centre, then the section's view routine

B0:B266.desc: view routine of the asteroid pages: page 2 P2_9983 views the asteroid records

B0:B5D4.desc: adds the bonus for the level the game was started at, called once at frame $40 of the wave completed phase when $4C62 is set. GM_WAV 0 (easy) adds nothing, 1 adds 100000, 2 adds 250000 (the table at $B724, messages $4F-$51), 3 and up (continued play, message $52) adds the 8-digit bcd bonus carried over at $4BEF and shows it as the amount being added

B0:B72D.name: VWSITE
B0:B72D.desc: Star Wars' VWSITE with view_cockpit in the place of VWPLAN: the cursor in its normal colour (VWCURS), then the cockpit. Y = display list

B0:B734.name: VWSITC
B0:B734.desc: Star Wars' VWSITC likewise: the cursor without a colour instruction (VWCURC), then the cockpit. no caller found

B0:C4DA.desc: send sound command A to the sound board through DOXMT, but only while snd_mute is zero - when it is set the command is dropped. the effect stubs from $32 up jump here, except $34, $36, $40, $44 and $52, so the dying phases, which set snd_mute to 1, silence the effects. bank 1 has its own copy at K6530

B0:C4EA.name: spk_cmd_03
B0:C4EA.desc: sound stub: sends command $03 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 10 of its table. sent by page 0 (P0_8F5B) in the walker part when w2_spk_cnt reaches 20. the Star Wars name SPKALW was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C4EF.name: spk_cmd_04
B0:C4EF.desc: sound stub: sends command $04 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 15 of its table. sent by DO1GAS when one shield is left in the probot and walker parts. the Star Wars name SPKELE was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C4F4.name: spk_cmd_05
B0:C4F4.desc: sound stub: sends command $05 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 9 of its table. sent by page 2 (P2_92F3) at the first probot shot down in a game (foa_said). the Star Wars name SPKFOA was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C4F9.name: spk_cmd_06
B0:C4F9.desc: sound stub: sends command $06 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 1 of its table. sent by S2VW (pages 2 and 3) when a ship starts a pass-by. the sound board says it only when no speech is under way. the Star Wars name SPKFOR was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C4FE.name: spk_cmd_07
B0:C4FE.desc: sound stub: sends command $07 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 3 of its table. sent by page 1 (P1_95C3) when a Jedi letter is awarded, except the third. the Star Wars name SPKGRE was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C503.name: spk_cmd_08
B0:C503.desc: sound stub: sends command $08 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 23 of its table. sent when the probot part ends in wave 2 (GM_WAV 1), and one of the four picked at random from wave 4 on (w1_end_spk). the Star Wars name SPKHAV was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C508.name: spk_cmd_09
B0:C508.desc: sound stub: sends command $09 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 12 of its table. sent by page 0 (P0_9641) once in a walker part (hit_spk_done). the Star Wars name SPKHIT was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C50D.name: spk_cmd_0a
B0:C50D.desc: sound stub: sends command $0A through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 17 of its table. sent by IFRAME when the first credit comes in and by phe_jedi_award at frame 50. the Star Wars name SPKI was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C512.name: spk_cmd_0b
B0:C512.desc: sound stub: sends command $0B through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is the warm start of the speech chip, queued like a sentence (its SPKI). nothing calls this stub. the Star Wars name SPKIMO was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C517.name: spk_cmd_0c
B0:C517.desc: sound stub: sends command $0C through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrases 4, 2 and 5 of its table. sent by phi_set_done when a wave is completed. the Star Wars name SPKLET was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C51C.name: spk_cmd_0d
B0:C51C.desc: sound stub: sends command $0D through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 6 of its table. sent by PHISG1 when the start switch is accepted. the Star Wars name SPKLOS was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C521.name: spk_cmd_0e
B0:C521.desc: sound stub: sends command $0E through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 19 of its table. sent by the probot part's setup in the waves with an even GM_WAV. the Star Wars name SPKR2N was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C526.name: spk_cmd_0f
B0:C526.desc: sound stub: sends command $0F through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 13 of its table. sent by the probot part's setup in the waves with an odd GM_WAV. the Star Wars name SPKR2T was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C52B.name: spk_cmd_10
B0:C52B.desc: sound stub: sends command $10 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 20 of its table. sent when the probot part ends in wave 3 (GM_WAV 2), and one of the four picked at random from wave 4 on (w1_end_spk). the Star Wars name SPKRED was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C530.name: spk_cmd_11
B0:C530.desc: sound stub: sends command $11 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 22 of its table. one of the four speeches picked at random when the probot part ends from wave 4 on (w1_end_spk). the Star Wars name SPKREM was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C535.name: spk_cmd_12
B0:C535.desc: sound stub: sends command $12 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 7 of its table. sent by page 1 (P1_9C4B) when the walkers' advance reaches its last mark (prog_count 0) in a wave with an even GM_WAV. the Star Wars name SPKSHK was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C53A.name: spk_cmd_13
B0:C53A.desc: sound stub: sends command $13 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is the command that drops the speech still waiting in its queue (its SPKSKP). sent before a speech that must not wait: by the five dying phases, PHIEGM, the end of the probot part, DO1GAS and page 1 when a shot hits the ship. the Star Wars name SPKSIZ was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C53F.name: spk_cmd_14
B0:C53F.desc: sound stub: sends command $14 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 18 of its table. sent by page 1 (P1_95BE) when the third Jedi letter is awarded. the Star Wars name SPKSKP was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C544.name: spk_cmd_15
B0:C544.desc: sound stub: sends command $15 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 14 of its table. sent by page 1 (P1_9C50) when the walkers' advance reaches its last mark in a wave with an odd GM_WAV. the Star Wars name SPKSTA was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C549.name: spk_cmd_16
B0:C549.desc: sound stub: sends command $16 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 21 of its table. sent when the probot part ends in wave 1 (GM_WAV 0), and one of the four picked at random from wave 4 on (w1_end_spk). the Star Wars name SPKSTR was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C54E.name: spk_cmd_17
B0:C54E.desc: sound stub: sends command $17 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 11 of its table. sent by page 1 (P1_9C3C) when the walkers' advance passes its first mark (prog_count 3) while $4CD6 is 0. the Star Wars name SPKTHI was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C553.name: spk_cmd_18
B0:C553.desc: sound stub: sends command $18 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 8 of its table. sent by the walker part's setup. the Star Wars name SPKTRU was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C558.name: spk_cmd_19
B0:C558.desc: sound stub: sends command $19 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 24 of its table. sent by page 1 (P1_94E4), once a part, when a shot hits the ship while its shield still glows, in the probot and walker parts. the Star Wars name SPKUSE was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C55D.name: spk_cmd_1a
B0:C55D.desc: sound stub: sends command $1A through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 16 of its table. sent at frame 8 of dying in the probot part, in the walker part and in the plain dying phase. the Star Wars name SPKYAU was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C562.name: spk_cmd_1b
B0:C562.desc: sound stub: sends command $1B through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 32 of its table. sent at frame 8 of dying in the TIE fighter and asteroid parts. the Star Wars name PMBEN was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C567.name: spk_cmd_1c
B0:C567.desc: sound stub: sends command $1C through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 26 of its table. sent by the asteroid part's setup in wave 1 (GM_WAV 0). the Star Wars name PMCNT was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C56C.name: spk_cmd_1d
B0:C56C.desc: sound stub: sends command $1D through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 29 of its table. sent by page 1 (P1_94BD) at the first enemy shot that hits the ship in the TIE fighter part. the Star Wars name PMDAR was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C571.name: spk_cmd_1e
B0:C571.desc: sound stub: sends command $1E through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrases 35 and 36 of its table. sent by PHEEGM when a game without high score or continue offer ended in the probot or walker part. the Star Wars name PMDES was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C576.name: spk_cmd_1f
B0:C576.desc: sound stub: sends command $1F through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 34 of its table. sent by the asteroid part's setup, after command $22, in the waves with an even GM_WAV from 2 on. the Star Wars name PMEND was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C57B.name: spk_cmd_20
B0:C57B.desc: sound stub: sends command $20 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 27 of its table. sent by phe_asteroids 40 frames before the asteroid part ends. the Star Wars name PM4TH was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C580.name: spk_cmd_21
B0:C580.desc: sound stub: sends command $21 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 30 of its table. sent by DO1GAS when the last shield is lost in the TIE fighter and asteroid parts. the Star Wars name PMREB was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C585.name: spk_cmd_22
B0:C585.desc: sound stub: sends command $22 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 37 of its table. sent by the asteroid part's setup in the waves with an even GM_WAV from 2 on. the Star Wars name PMRRP was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C58A.name: spk_cmd_23
B0:C58A.desc: sound stub: sends command $23 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 31 of its table. sent by wave2_exit_init when the walker part is over. the Star Wars name PMSF2 was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C58F.name: spk_cmd_24
B0:C58F.desc: sound stub: sends command $24 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 25 of its table. sent by the TIE fighter part's setup. the Star Wars name PMTH5 was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C594.name: spk_cmd_25
B0:C594.desc: sound stub: sends command $25 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 38 of its table. sent by page 1 (P1_94C9) at the first enemy shot that hits the ship in the asteroid part. the Star Wars name PMTHB was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C599.name: spk_cmd_26
B0:C599.desc: sound stub: sends command $26 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 39 of its table. sent by the asteroid part's setup in the waves with an odd GM_WAV. the Star Wars name AUDCR was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C59E.name: spk_cmd_27
B0:C59E.desc: sound stub: sends command $27 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 33 of its table. sent by page 1 (P1_94E9), once a part, when a shot hits the ship while its shield still glows, in the TIE fighter and asteroid parts. the Star Wars name AUDDF was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C5A3.name: spk_cmd_28
B0:C5A3.desc: sound stub: sends command $28 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is speech, phrase 40 of its table. nothing calls this stub. the sound board says it only when no speech is under way. the Star Wars name AUDDR was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C5A8.name: tune_cmd_29
B0:C5A8.desc: sound stub: sends command $29 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is a tune (the sound board's tunes 35-38, melody not identified). sent by the asteroid part's setup while jedi_time is under $80, and one of the five attract tunes of TMUSIC. the Star Wars name AUDNAY was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C5AD.name: tune_cmd_2a
B0:C5AD.desc: sound stub: sends command $2A through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is a tune, Ben's theme (tunes 7-10). sent by page 1 (P1_95E5) when the fourth Jedi letter is earned, and one of the five attract tunes of TMUSIC. the Star Wars name AUDPB was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C5B2.name: tune_cmd_2b
B0:C5B2.desc: sound stub: sends command $2B through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is a tune, the Imperial March (tunes 15-18). sent by the walker part's setup while jedi_time is under $80, and one of the five attract tunes of TMUSIC. the Star Wars name AUDPBZ was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C5B7.name: tune_cmd_2c
B0:C5B7.desc: sound stub: sends command $2C through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is a tune (tunes 23-26, melody not identified). sent by the TIE fighter part's setup while jedi_time is under $80. the Star Wars name AUDPF was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C5BC.name: tune_cmd_2d
B0:C5BC.desc: sound stub: sends command $2D through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is a tune, descending semitone scales (tunes 1-4). nothing calls this stub. the Star Wars name AUDPH was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C5C1.name: tune_cmd_2e
B0:C5C1.desc: sound stub: sends command $2E through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is a tune, the Star Wars main theme (tunes 27-30). sent by the probot part's setup, and one of the five attract tunes of TMUSIC. the Star Wars name AUDPS was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C5C6.name: tune_cmd_2f
B0:C5C6.desc: sound stub: sends command $2F through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is a tune, the rhythm figure of the Imperial March looped (tunes 43-46). sent by launch_init for the opening text. the Star Wars name AUDRC was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C5CB.name: tune_cmd_30
B0:C5CB.desc: sound stub: sends command $30 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is a tune (tunes 39-42, by its notes perhaps Yoda's theme). sent by PHEEGM when a game ends without high score or continue offer. the Star Wars name AUDRD was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C5D0.name: tune_cmd_31
B0:C5D0.desc: sound stub: sends command $31 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is a tune (tunes 31-34, melody not identified). sent by PHIENT when the initials entry starts, and one of the five attract tunes of TMUSIC. the Star Wars name AUDRS was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C5D5.name: aud_cmd_32
B0:C5D5.desc: sound stub: sends command $32 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table CR0, crash, which Star Wars' AUDCR requested. sent by pages 0 and 1 (P0_914F, P1_89AA) when the ship runs into a walker. the Star Wars name AUDRY was carried here by the command number, which meant another sound there

B0:C5DA.name: aud_cmd_33
B0:C5DA.desc: sound stub: sends command $33 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table DF0, the final explosion, which Star Wars' AUDDF requested. sent by page 1 (P1_9C28) when the walkers' advance reaches its last mark (prog_count 0)

B0:C5DF.name: aud_cmd_34
B0:C5DF.desc: sound stub: sends command $34 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table NAY0, nay - test failed, which Star Wars' AUDNAY requested. nothing calls this stub: the self test sends $34 itself as its error sound

B0:C5E4.name: aud_cmd_35
B0:C5E4.desc: sound stub: sends command $35 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table PB0, pass-by, which Star Wars' AUDPB requested. sent by S2VW (pages 2 and 3) when a ship starts a pass-by

B0:C5E9.name: aud_cmd_36
B0:C5E9.desc: sound stub: sends command $36 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is the table PBZ0, which ends the pass-by sound, as Star Wars' AUDPBZ did. sent by XPSA (P3_8A3D) when the ship that explodes is the one passing by. not gated by snd_mute. the self test's sound test leaves it out

B0:C5EE.name: aud_cmd_37
B0:C5EE.desc: sound stub: sends command $37 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table PF0, tower pfffts, which Star Wars' AUDPF requested. nothing calls this stub

B0:C5F3.name: aud_cmd_38
B0:C5F3.desc: sound stub: sends command $38 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table PH0, port hole shot, which Star Wars' AUDPH requested. nothing in bank 0 or the pages calls this stub. bank 1's copy is called from the initials entry

B0:C5F8.name: aud_cmd_39
B0:C5F8.desc: sound stub: sends command $39 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table PS0, short pass-by, which Star Wars' AUDPS requested. sent by S2VW (pages 2 and 3) when the ship passing by starts to move away

B0:C5FD.name: aud_cmd_3a
B0:C5FD.desc: sound stub: sends command $3A through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table SH0, shield, which Star Wars' AUDSH requested. sent by DO1GAS when a shield is lost, by page 1 (P1_94FE) when a shot hits the ship and by page 2 (P2_9AF3) when an asteroid does

B0:C602.name: aud_cmd_3b
B0:C602.desc: sound stub: sends command $3B through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table SS0, shoot shots, which Star Wars' AUDSS requested. sent by page 1 (P1_9527) when the lazar destroys an enemy shot and by page 3 (P3_9D23) when it hits a probot transmission

B0:C607.name: aud_cmd_3c
B0:C607.desc: sound stub: sends command $3C through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table SX0, small explosion, which Star Wars' AUDSX requested. sent by page 1 (P1_8E75) when an AT-ST is destroyed and by page 3 (CPHTSA, XPSA) when a TIE fighter is hit

B0:C60C.name: aud_cmd_3d
B0:C60C.desc: sound stub: sends command $3D through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table XL0, which Star Wars' AUDTC requested for the TIE fighter cannon. sent by page 1 when a TIE fighter (P1_8F82) or a probot (P1_90C6) fires a shot

B0:C611.name: aud_cmd_3e
B0:C611.desc: sound stub: sends command $3E through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is the table XLZ0, which ends the sound of command $3D, as Star Wars' AUDTCZ did. sent by page 1 (P1_9524) when the lazar destroys an enemy shot. the self test's sound test leaves it out

B0:C616.name: aud_cmd_3f
B0:C616.desc: sound stub: sends command $3F through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table BL0, the player's laser blast, which Star Wars' AUDXL requested. sent by TSTLAZ (P3_95BA) when the lazars fire in the TIE fighter and asteroid parts

B0:C61B.name: aud_cmd_40
B0:C61B.desc: sound stub: sends command $40 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is the effect of Atari's table YEA0, yea - test successful, which Star Wars' AUDYEA requested. nothing calls this stub: the self test sends $40 itself as its no-error sound

B0:C620.name: aud_cmd_41
B0:C620.desc: sound stub: sends command $41 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (2 channels, noise, about 0.4 s). sent by page 1 when an AT-AT (P1_8FEE) or an AT-ST (P1_905A) fires a shot

B0:C625.name: aud_cmd_42
B0:C625.desc: sound stub: sends command $42 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (1 channel, about 0.4 s). nothing calls this stub

B0:C62A.name: aud_cmd_43
B0:C62A.desc: sound stub: sends command $43 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (2 channels, pure tone, about 2.5 s). sent by page 3 (P3_995A) when a probot launches a transmission

B0:C62F.name: aud_cmd_44
B0:C62F.desc: sound stub: sends command $44 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is a table of end marks that silences the two channels of commands $43 and $45. sent by page 3 (P3_9D20) when the lazar hits a transmission and no other transmission is live. not gated by snd_mute. the self test's sound test leaves it out

B0:C634.name: aud_cmd_45
B0:C634.desc: sound stub: sends command $45 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (2 channels, noise, about 6.1 s). sent by wave2_exit_init when the walker part is over

B0:C639.name: aud_cmd_46
B0:C639.desc: sound stub: sends command $46 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (2 channels, pure tone, about 0.8 s). sent by page 1 (P1_9A02) just before flash_fade is set to $7F, not while a training manual page is shown

B0:C63E.name: aud_cmd_47
B0:C63E.desc: sound stub: sends command $47 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (3 channels, noise, about 4.8 s). sent by launch_init for the opening text

B0:C643.name: aud_cmd_48
B0:C643.desc: sound stub: sends command $48 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (1 channel, about 1.1 s). sent by page 1 (P1_9C2D) when the walkers' advance passes a mark that is not the last

B0:C648.name: aud_cmd_49
B0:C648.desc: sound stub: sends command $49 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (2 channels, noise, about 0.9 s). sent by page 2 (P2_9AF6) when an asteroid hits the ship

B0:C64D.name: aud_cmd_4a
B0:C64D.desc: sound stub: sends command $4A through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (2 channels, noise, about 4.5 s). sent by phi_jedi_award when the asteroid field is passed

B0:C652.name: aud_cmd_4b
B0:C652.desc: sound stub: sends command $4B through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (1 channel, noise, about 2.8 s). sent by page 0 (P0_95BA) where $4BFE is counted down

B0:C657.name: aud_cmd_4c
B0:C657.desc: sound stub: sends command $4C through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (2 channels, pure tone, about 0.7 s). sent by scr_legs_bonus when the player flies through an AT-AT's legs

B0:C65C.name: aud_cmd_4d
B0:C65C.desc: sound stub: sends command $4D through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (1 channel, about 0.2 s). sent by TSTLAZ (P3_95B5) when the lazars fire in the probot and walker parts

B0:C661.name: aud_cmd_4e
B0:C661.desc: sound stub: sends command $4E through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (2 channels, about 0.9 s). sent by page 2 (P2_9327) when a probot is shot down

B0:C666.name: aud_cmd_4f
B0:C666.desc: sound stub: sends command $4F through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (1 channel, about 0.9 s). sent by page 0 (P0_9927)

B0:C66B.name: aud_cmd_50
B0:C66B.desc: sound stub: sends command $50 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (1 channel, about 6.1 s). sent by page 1 (P1_963F), once, when jedi_time falls under $60

B0:C670.name: aud_cmd_51
B0:C670.desc: sound stub: sends command $51 through doxmt_gated, which on ESB's sound board is an effect ESB added (2 channels, noise, about 1.1 s). sent by page 0 (P0_904A) when an AT-AT is destroyed. the last command the self test's sound test plays

B0:C675.name: aud_cmd_52
B0:C675.desc: sound stub: sends command $52 through DOXMT, which on ESB's sound board is a command it has no routine for: its command table ends at $51 and the word it takes for $52 is the ROM's checksum word. sent by page 1 (P1_962A) when jedi_time runs out. not gated by snd_mute. the self test's sound test leaves it out

B0:E779.desc: as mes_lines_scroll but each line's colour word takes only its high byte from mes_colour_tab and its brightness from ph_col_brt, so the whole text can be faded. Used by VWMES2

B0:F4E3.name: snd_test
B0:F4E3.desc: self test state 2, the sound test, which ESB put where Star Wars has its checker board state: draws the screen boundary, the messages SOUND TEST and SOUND and the index of the chosen sound, and sends the command from sound_test_tab when snd_test_tmr runs out

B0:F56F.name: SCHKR
B0:F56F.desc: Star Wars' SCHKR, the checker board state of the self test, reached through the state table: the JSRL to the checker pattern, then GETBAK

questions: the names GM_DIF ($4C49), GM_BMP ($4C58) and Q_RTHV ($4CCA) that the b0 notes use are not symbols of the listing: the three addresses were bare. by the code $4C49 is Star Wars' GM_WAV (PHESDS stores the selected wave in it, PHIBGN makes the BCD wave number from it, PHENXT bumps it - B0:68B4, B0:6B5B, B0:72D7), so this file names it GM_WAV, drops the false GM_WAV = $508A and names $508A s1_by. $4C58 and $4CCA are ESB's own (quota_astrd, snd_mute). every text of the b0 files that used the three names is overridden here with the new names

by the same reasoning $4C5A is Star Wars' GM_DIF and $4C59 its GM_BMP (B0:6809 takes the difficulty option into $4C5A as PHESG1 does, B0:72CB-72D4 is PHENXT's LDA GM_BMP / INCA ... ADDA GM_BMP / STA GM_DIF), $4C4A is GM_DWAV and $4CD0 COINSP. they keep the annotators' lower-case names diff_adder, diff_step, wave_bcd and coin_spoken here, because the b0 texts used GM_DIF and GM_BMP for other addresses - the maintainer may want the Atari names
